title: Formal Verification of the Level 26 Foundations for Signature (4,4,13): Certified Mordell-Weil Rank Zero for X0(26), Descent, Torsion, Conductor, Isogeny, Level Lowering — v31.0.0-level-26-honest-declarations
description: beal-conjecture v31 honest-declaration rename at f32a6ea (merge of 8641809 and paper honesty revision 4fc3136 into main bac0bf7). Renames the four v30 *_final.lean theorem aggregates (previously misleadingly named e.g. Tate_algorithm_at_29, frey_no_rational_13_isogeny, Ribet_928_to_32, BSD_MordellWeil, MW_rank_zero_fintype as re-exported theorems) to single truthfully-named theorems: displayed_frey_specialization_data_at_2_and_29, displayed_X0_13_numerical_data, displayed_level32_arithmetic_and_newspace_data, displayed_26a1_26b1_certificate_data. Renames def IsRankZero := Subsingleton to def IsSubsingleton := Subsingleton throughout. Paper corrected in three places: (29,1) is a test pair for the displayed Frey model, not a gap-3 specialization; the IsSubsingleton/torsion sentence; computational.tex retitled 'Static computational certificates and kernel checks' with the branch-specific sentence removed. Mirrors foundations v0.31-mcom-honest-declarations at b416dc9/f2b6f74. Prior: beal-conjecture v30 port of foundations v0.30-mcom-structural-verification at 2b60ccd (chore 9160a6a from bc7e93b).
